description_en: Builds a custom image based on the specified configuration. After the image is successfully built, it is added to the list of custom images in the current workspace
description_zh: 根据指定配置构建自定义镜像， 构建成功后，会添加到当前工作空间的自定义镜像里
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace create-image-build --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --accessibility PUBLIC --workspace-id 12345 --resource '{"ResourceId":"quotaadzoqup693z","EcsSpec":"ecs.c6.large","ResourceType":"Lingjun","ResourceConfig":{"Memory":"8Gi","CPU":"4"}}' --user-vpc '{"VpcId":"vpc-abcdef00","SecurityGroupId":"sg-abcdef00","DefaultRoute":"eth1","SwitchId":"vs-abcdef00","ExtendedCidrs":["10.0.0.0/24"]}' --target-registry Type=AcrEnterprise InstanceId=cri-00abcd --overwrite-image-tag true --build-config '{"Dockerfile":"FROM_ubuntu:18:04_RUN_pip3_install_numpy==1.19.5","BuildType":"PackageInstallation","RegistryAuths":{"user-test-registry-vpc.cn-wulanchabu.cr.aliyuncs.com":{"Auth":"dXNlcjp0ZXN0"}}}' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-build-job-name build-my-image --image '{"Description":"Build_test_image","Labels":[{"Value":"value1","Key":"key1"}],"Uri":"user-test-registry-vpc.cn-wulanchabu.cr.aliyuncs.com/pai-test/pai-test:test-v1","Name":"test-v1"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageBuild

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the image.

PUBLIC: The image is public.

PRIVATE: The image is private
parameters.help_zh:
可见性
PUBLIC 公有
PRIVATE 私有
parameters.name: accessibility

fields.help_en:
The build type. The following types are supported:

PackageInstallation: Installs software packages based on a specified image.

CustomDockerfile: Builds an image based on a custom Dockerfile
fields.help_zh:
构建类型，当前支持以下两种类型：
PackageInstallation ： 基于指定镜像安装软件包。
CustomDockerfile：基于定制 Dockerfile
fields.name: build_type

fields.example:
FROM ubuntu:18:04
RUN pip3 install numpy==1.19.5
fields.help_en: The content of the Dockerfile to be built
fields.help_zh: 指定待构建的 Dockerfile 文件内容
fields.name: dockerfile

fields.help_en: The authentication information for the private image repository. You can specify the authentication information for an ACR image repository that does not belong to you. The format is \`{"user\_registry\_domain":{"Auth":"base64 encoded auth"}}\`
fields.help_zh: 私有镜像仓库鉴权信息。可以指定非当前用户的 ACR 镜像仓库的鉴权信息，格式：{"user_registry_domain":{"Auth":"base64 encoded auth"}}
fields.name: registry_auths

parameters.help_en: The build configuration. Specify the content of the Dockerfile to be built
parameters.help_zh: 构建配置，指定待构建的 Dockerfile 文件内容
parameters.name: build_config

fields.help_en: The description of the image
fields.help_zh: 镜像描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The key of the image label
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签的键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the image label
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签的值
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The image labels
fields.help_zh: 镜像标签
fields.name: labels

fields.help_en:
The name of the image. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

The name must be unique within the same workspace
fields.help_zh:
命名规则如下：
长度为 1~50 个英文字符。
支持小写字母、数字和短横线（-），以字母开头。
同一工作空间内不可重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The image URL
fields.help_zh: 镜像地址
fields.name: uri

parameters.help_en: The name of the image build task
parameters.name: image_build_job_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to overwrite an existing image version in the image repository
parameters.help_zh: 是否覆盖更新镜像仓库中已经存在的镜像版本
parameters.name: overwrite_image_tag

fields.help_en: The instance type of the pay-as-you-go resource. This parameter is required when you use the public resource group
fields.help_zh: 后付费资源规格。使用“公共资源组”时，此参数必填
fields.name: ecs_spec

fields.help_en: The number of CPU cores
fields.help_zh: CPU 核心数
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory size
fields.help_zh: 内存容量
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The resource configuration. Specify this parameter when you use subscription resources. Leave it empty when you use the public resource group
fields.help_zh: 资源配置。使用预付费资源时需要指定，使用“公共资源组”时为空
fields.name: resource_config

fields.help_en: The resource quota ID. This parameter applies only to subscription resources. Do not set this parameter for pay-as-you-go resources
fields.help_zh: 资源配额 ID。仅针对预付费资源，使用后付费资源时不设置
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en: The type of the subscription resource. Currently, only Lingjun resources are supported. Specify this parameter when you use subscription resources
fields.help_zh: 预付费资源类型。目前只支持灵骏资源，使用预付费资源时需要指定
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resources used to run the task
parameters.name: resource

fields.help_en: The ID of the image repository instance. This parameter is required when you use ACR as the image repository
fields.help_zh: 镜像服务实例 ID。 使用 ACR 作为镜像服务时，此参数必填
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The type of the target image repository. Only ACR Enterprise Edition is supported
fields.help_zh: 当前只支持企业版 ACR 作为目标镜像服务
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the target image repository
parameters.name: target_registry

fields.help_en:
The default route.

eth1: Indicates that the user's elastic network interface (ENI) is used to access the external network through a private gateway. For more information, see Configure a Distribution Switch (DSW) instance to access the Internet through a private NAT gateway (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/configure-a-dsw-instance-to-access-the-internet-through-a-private-nat-gateway?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.3b3965f6SZWm85)
fields.help_zh:
默认路由。
eth1：表示使用用户弹性网卡，通过私有网关访问外部网络。具体配置方法，请参考配置 DSW 实例通过专有公网网关访问公网 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/configure-a-dsw-instance-to-access-the-internet-through-a-private-nat-gateway?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.3b3965f6SZWm85)
fields.name: default_route

fields.help_en:
The extended CIDR blocks.

If you do not specify a vSwitch ID, you can leave this parameter empty. The system automatically obtains all CIDR blocks of the VPC.

If you specify a vSwitch ID, you must specify this parameter. For best results, include all CIDR blocks of the VPC
fields.help_zh:
扩展网段。
当交换机 ID 为空时，此参数可以不提供，系统会自动获取 VPC 下的所有网段；
当交换机 ID 不为空时，此参数必须提供，建议填写 VPC 下的所有网段
fields.name: extended_cidrs

fields.help_en: The security group ID. This parameter is required when you configure a VPC
fields.help_zh: 安全组 ID。指定专有网络配置时，此参数必填
fields.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: 交换机 ID，可选
fields.name: switch_id

fields.help_en: The VPC ID. If the build task needs to access your ACR Enterprise Edition instance, specify a VPC that is in the access control list of the instance
fields.help_zh: 专有网络 ID。构建任务访问用户企业版 ACR 实例时，需要指定在用户 ACR 实例的访问控制里已添加的专有网络
fields.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The information about the user's virtual private cloud (VPC). This parameter is required when you use the public resource group
parameters.help_zh: 用户专有网络信息。使用“公共资源组”时，此参数必填
parameters.name: user_vpc
